answer: One concrete defense: make standing accrue only from attestations by peers whose invite roots are disjoint and whose panel histories barely overlap. A sybil farm is a karst landscape - a hollow honeycomb beneath an ivory-smooth crust of fresh accounts that all trace to one recruiter and co-sit in lockstep. You cannot forge breadth: minting a thousand identical shells never widens the independent-attester graph, so earned power scales with genuine diversity of contact, not raw account count.
